artworks.title: Industrie chinoise
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various barrels and individuals interacting with them. The image shows three figures handling and inspecting large wooden barrels. One figure pours liquid from a small barrel into a funnel set into a larger barrel, while another observes closely, holding a bottle in one hand. The third figure stands passively near the barrels. The drawing features detailed, cross-hatched shading on the wooden barrels and clothing of the figures. The detailed lines create a sense of realism and movement within the drawing.

artworks.title: Madame, comment trouvez-vous cette cigarette?
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals in an indoor setting. The first person is a woman seated in a chair, holding a cigarette. The second person is a man standing. The woman has dark, long hair and wears a gown. The man has a long face with a beard, and he is wearing a long-sleeved garment and coat. There are books on a desk nearby, and the background is a simple, unadorned wall.

artworks.title: Reviens y donc encore ... grand enjeoleu! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration of two individuals and a dog in an outdoor setting. The scene depicts a man on the left and a woman on the right, with a dog in the middle. The man is slightly turned to the side and seems to be in discomfort, while the woman appears to be restraining the dog by its collar. In the background, there is a tree and distant landscape elements. The focus is on the interaction between the characters.

artworks.title: J'vous dis que vous avez dérangé la limite ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men facing each other from the waist up. The man on the left is standing with a stick or pole in front of him. He has a mustache, wears a hat and is dressed in a dark coat. The man on the right looks indignant, with furrowed eyebrows and an open mouth. He wears a patterned coat and has his arms crossed. Both men have different colored hair and hats with brims. In the background, there are rolling hills, a cloudy sky, and mountains or hills in the distance. Faint words or lines suggest a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Ah! Saperlotte! ... Le raisin n'est pas bon cette année! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals working in a vineyard. The scene captures a vineyard rich with grapevines laden with grape clusters, set against a backdrop of rolling clouds and a solitary tree. Amongst the clusters, an individual in a top hat inspects the grapes. Other figures can be seen carrying baskets for grape harvesting. The drawing uses intricate shading to create depth, with a fluid and dynamic style illustrating the bustling activity of harvesting. The focus on expression potentially indicates a humorous or critical element typical of caricatures. The style resembles that of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Femme de lettre humanitaire se livrant sur l'homme ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in a cartoon sketch style. Two individuals stand next to each other, covering their bodies. The man is on the left, holding a cane in each hand. He has a long nose, a top hat, and a formal suit. Next to him, a woman faces slightly toward the third figure. She wears a bonnet, has wide eyes, and wears a long checkered dress with a shawl. The third individual, an older woman, is hunched forward, extending a bowl toward the couple. She appears wrinkled with her hair tied back under a headscarf, wearing a loose top and long skirt. The background includes a textured wall and some text above and below the image.

artworks.title: Un service d'ami
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classroom scene with a teacher and students. The artwork depicts a classroom setting where a teacher sits behind a desk, looking at a book, while three students are positioned in front of the desk. One of the students is holding a book and wearing a paper hat. Another student is focused on writing or reading at a closer position to the desk, while the third stands closely observing. The lines are etched in a manner typical of caricatures or satirical commentary, with exaggerated expressions. The composition suggests an educational environment, potentially conveying a humorous critique of student-teacher interactions. Shadows and shading are used effectively to enhance the depth and characters' expressions.

artworks.title: Une émeute
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of a classroom filled with chaos. Books and papers are airborne while a teacher, dressed formally, stands at the center. Surrounding the teacher are enthusiastic students, raising their hands and holding sticks. The composition is dynamic and captures the energy of the scenario. In the lower portion of the drawing, there are printed words that add context to the satire and humor of the image.

artworks.title: Monsieur Adolphe Chamouillard vous vous montrerez donc ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group gathered around a dining table. The central figure, wearing a dark suit and tie, appears to be serving food with a surprised or indignant expression. Seated at the table are several smaller figures with distinct features. The table is set with plates and a large bottle. The characters' expressions and postures, along with the visual style, suggest a satirical commentary on a formal dining experience in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Promenade hygiénique et sentimentale ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of seven individuals closely standing together in a row, with the tallest on the left and others decreasing in height towards the right. Each person is mainly seen from the waist up, facing forward with a slight turn to the left. All individuals are wearing tall top hats and coats of varying details. The person on the far left has distinct facial features and is wearing a dark coat with a tie. One individual in the foreground, second from the right, has an open mouth. The background features sketch-like outlines of tall buildings, suggesting an urban environment. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Triste sort des professeurs ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a classroom setting where beetles are causing chaos. The instructor looks surprised as the beetles fly towards them, while students at their desks interact with the insects. Items on the desks imply an educational setting. The drawing conveys a satirical or comedic tone through the unexpected disruption by the beetles.

artworks.title: Vous voyez ... l'orde le plus parfait règne ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Three men are in the foreground of the image along with a group of students in the background of a classroom setting. The man on the right is shown from head to waist, with a round face, large eyes, and short, curly hair. He is wearing a coat over a shirt, possibly with a high collar. In the middle is a man with an elongated facial profile, sharp cheekbones, and a prominent nose, facing to the side with curly hair and a long coat. The man on the left is depicted with a surprised expression, wide-opened eyes, an open mouth, one hand raised, short, tidy hair, and a coat. In the background, several young students with short hair are sitting, facing away, focused on their studies. There is a window or picture frame on the wall. No jewelry is visible on the men, and they are not holding objects. The setting appears to be a classroom with formal attire, consistent with a school or educational institution.

artworks.title: Dans cette réclame que vous allez envoyer ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classroom interaction involving a teacher and a student. The image shows a teacher gesturing grandly and a student sitting with papers in front of them. The teacher appears to be holding a bouquet of objects that resemble radishes or carrots. In the background, there is a large tabletop with a chart or diagram. French text at the bottom of the image adds to the context.

artworks.title: Une Panique a la bourse
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a detailed illustration of a crowded stock exchange. The scene includes people in top hats displaying expressions of panic and urgency. One central figure is waving papers in the air, while others around them are in motion, reaching out or turning away. The background features contrasting light and shadow, adding to the intensity of the image. The style of the illustration is reminiscent of 19th-century political satire or social commentary.

artworks.title: Le dernier jour de la réception des tableaux. Saperlotte . . . Nous voici déjà arrivés et mon tableau n'est pas fini!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people carrying oversized paintings. The scene depicts individuals moving large canvases towards a building marked "MUSÉE ROYAL." In the foreground, a figure with a beard and dressed in a long robe leads the way, carrying a palette and brush. The people in the background are wearing hats and are focused on transporting the artworks. The setting is an urban area with a cobblestone street and buildings. The drawing conveys a sense of urgency and movement, with the text indicating the "last day for accepting paintings."

artworks.title: Dire ... que c'st comme ça qu'on améliore les chevaux ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing and observing a scene. The two figures are dressed in formal clothing with top hats, suggesting a time period characteristic of the 19th century. They stand on a hill or embankment, overlooking a crowd of similarly dressed individuals gathered at a distance. Below them, more figures are aligned, also observing the unseen event. The background is made of blurred foliage or structures, with the suggestion of a public gathering or event taking place in a landscaped area. The style of the drawing indicates a sense of satire or caricature, focusing on the demeanor and expressions of the figures, possibly providing a social commentary on the demeanor or society of the time.

artworks.title: Un pierrot déplumé
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are standing facing each other. The man on the left is leaning forward, holding a paper in his right hand with an expressive demeanor. He has a prominent nose, slightly furrowed brow, short messy hair, and is wearing a dark coat, pants, and shoes. A top hat is on the counter beside him. The man on the right is standing upright, facing the other man. He has sunken cheeks, a protruding chin, and is wearing a cap. He is dressed in a light-colored Pierrot clown outfit with pom-poms on his shirt. The background shows a shaded area with architectural elements like a column and paneling surrounding the figures.

artworks.title: V'la un particulier qui doit ...être inquiet ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a sketch showing two individuals depicted in full body length. The person on the left is positioned slightly turned away, with their back more visible than their front, walking with an animated posture that suggests motion. They have short hair covered by a cloth or cap and are wearing loose-fitting clothing, including pants and a shirt apparently tucked in or secured by a belt or sash, with a simple drape to their garment. To the right, there is an older gentleman slightly hunched over, walking with the assistance of a cane held in his left hand. He is wearing a tall top hat and formal attire, including a coat and trousers. His facial features exhibit a prominent nose, with the hat casting a shadow that occludes further detail. He is holding a book under his right arm. The setting appears to be on a cobblestone path or street. In the background, there is a large wall that curves from the ground upwards, creating a shadowed corner in the scene. The sketch is rendered in black and white.

artworks.title: Qué qu'vous êtes ... devenu, m'sieu Lebrun? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two men in conversation. One man is in formal attire while the other is dressed as a street vendor or tradesman, based on his apron and rolled-up sleeves. The setting suggests a street or market environment, with vague architectural lines in the background and shelving that holds several jugs or containers. The drawing uses bold outlines and shading to depict the characters and their interaction. The caption below the image adds context but is not fully explained without translation.

artworks.title: Ah! Ma chère, quand on a un chien ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing on a cobblestone street, facing each other and holding leashes with dogs. The woman on the left has curly hair under a bonnet and wears a long, dark coat over a patterned dress. The woman on the right has her hair mostly covered by a bonnet and wears a heavy cloak with a pattern. Both women have small dogs with them, one spotted and one with a fluffier coat. The background includes sketchy outlines of city buildings.

artworks.title: C'est pourtant la que j'ai gravé mon chiffre ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration of a man standing on the left side in profile, facing right. He is looking up at a tree. The man is wearing a striped coat, waistcoat, trousers, and a bow tie. He has short, wavy hair, and is holding a top hat in his left hand and a cane in his right hand. The background shows a stylized tree with branches and foliage. The ground and background are minimally detailed with sparse lines. Text above the illustration reads "TOUT CE QU'ON VOUDRA" and there is additional text below.

artworks.title: Inconvènient d'être trop sentimental ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoon-style drawing of two men. One man is walking barefoot in a suit and top hat with exaggerated facial features. The other man is partially hidden behind a large stone or wall, also wearing a suit and top hat. The background includes foliage and stone-like structures.

artworks.title: Je vous demande pardo si je ne vous ai pas apercue ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: There are two individuals captured outdoors. On the left, a man in a dark suit with curly hair bends slightly towards the woman. He holds a top hat behind his back. The woman on the right is seated, covered in a cloak with a hood. The background shows a garden or park setting with shrubs and trees.

artworks.title: Oui ... on a eu l'indignité de me refuser ce tableau ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing in front of a large framed painting on a wall. Both men are seen from the back, with their bodies slightly angled towards the painting they are observing. The man on the left is leaning forward, with his hand resting on the back of the other man. He has short, dark hair and is wearing a light-colored coat, dark trousers, and black shoes. The man on the right has slightly longer hair and is dressed in a coat and light trousers. He holds a hat in his right hand and is pointing towards the painting with his left hand. The painting is partially covered by a draped cloth. The room has other framed artworks on the walls; four are visible, with one being a portrait and another an indistinct abstract shape. The space has a wooden floor and a simple, textured wall surface.
